article: How to update the Rust compiler (rustc)
scope: Read the complete Japanese article and all twelve translations; compared the command, complete terminal transcript, terminology, metadata, links, and image. Checked update behavior and download-signature wording against official rustup documentation.
findings: Removed the duplicate future publication date from all editions, preserved the original publication date (2023-03-18), and set lastmod to 2026-11-25.
Labeled the captured rustup output as a March 2023 historical example so its version and component list are not mistaken for current output.

Added a warning that the sample reports signature verification failure and explained from rustup security documentation that downloads use HTTPS but signatures are not validated; readers should not treat the warning as successful verification.
Added localized links to the official rustup update and security documentation; command and captured output were compared across all editions.
